dedupe_keys.name: genesys mod gams energy system implementation

description: GENeSYS-MOD.gms is the GAMS implementation of the GENeSYS-MOD cross-sector energy-system model. It minimises total system cost while meeting externally specified demand through generation, conversion, storage and sector-coupling technologies. Users supply demands, technical costs, resource limits and planning years; outputs are capacity, operation and system-cost pathways for the study region. Geographic coverage is configurable, and the repository includes a test dataset for its documented version 3.0. Apache-2.0 source, model equations, a quick-start guide and full documentation are public. Running GAMS may require a separate licence and solver installation, which this review did not obtain. A limitation is that an optimum is conditional on input costs and constraints, not a prediction of policy adoption. GENeSYS-MOD can study power, fuels and transport transition infrastructure. The related catalogue OSeMOSYS model is a separate optimiser; a G7 Julia GENeSYS implementation is also drafted separately. No GAMS runtime or dataset was downloaded.
inputs: Energy demand, technology costs and planning constraints
